evidence: Truro permits page (200 2026-10-10): 'Please fill out the attached form below (or click the link to apply online) in order to apply for a Building or Development Permit'; 'Download the Town of Truro Building & Development Application Form 2023'

Work list on same page: new construction, structural change, demolition, relocation, change of occupancy/use, pools, repairs/renovations, interior alterations, accessory >20m2, decks/stairs, roof enclosure, re-roof pitch change
conditions_review.verdict: Precise as a MUNICIPALITY gate. Work-class precision: RENOVATION is a verbatim checkbox; finer per-class routing inside the single form is by applicant checkbox, not a product decision. Refinement: add needs_answer only for PDF-vs-webchannel choice (parity unknown).

evidence: CBRM permits page (200 2026-10-10): 'A permit is required for all structural and non-structural work valued at more than $10,000, including: New constructions, additions or structural alterations; Conversions or change of use; Garages, pools, decks' + 'You can include more than one type of work, such as renovations, additions or changes of use, in a single application'
CBRM forms hub (200): 'Building & Development Permits: Permit Application PDF, 266 KB'
conditions_review.verdict: Municipality gate is correct AND the $10,000 value threshold is source-backed: structural AND non-structural work >$10,000 needs a permit; non-structural <$10,000 (roofing, painting, shingles, siding, window/door replacement, fences, sheds <100 sq ft) does NOT. Recommend: CBRM question 'is the work valued over $10,000?' (needs_answer) before selecting the form; below-threshold → available-as-information only, not selected.

evidence: Schedule A page (200 2026-10-10): 'You need to submit Schedule A Letters of Undertaking with your application for a building permit if you use the services of engineers, architects or interior design professionals'
Same page: A10 with application, A11 before occupancy; filed 'as necessary' with plans to the local municipality
conditions_review.verdict: Condition matches the source's own if-clause. More precise: trigger = design professional ENGAGED for field review (not project type). 'As necessary' + no threshold table found → keep needs_answer wording exactly mirrored on the source ('Are engineers, architects or interior design professionals providing field reviews for this project?'). Never select Schedule A by default.

evidence: Fuel safety page links 'Gas Permit and Gas Registration (PDF)'; PDF p1: 'under section 18 of the Fuel Safety Regulations'; field names enumerate gas loads/equipment
conditions_review.verdict: Direction correct, precision limited: ONE form covers TWO instruments (Permit vs Registration) and the page does not state which installations need which. Recommend: question stays needs_answer with both outcomes mapping to the SAME form ('Gas installation work of any kind → form available'), and record instrument selection as unresolved (user + Technical Safety confirm). Do not split into two predicates without a source.

evidence: NSE wastewater forms page links all four forms by exact name; in-form header ties submission-details as 'required attachment' to the approval application; alert fields cite notification/approval numbers
conditions_review.verdict: Direction correct, precision limited: approval-vs-notification thresholds need regulation text (not found on inspected pages). Recommend: single needs_answer ('Does this project construct/alter an on-site sewage system?') → then present approval + notification as available (not auto-selected) with explicit 'confirm pathway with NSE' note; submission-details bundled with approval; alert available once a notification/approval number exists. Do not auto-select one pathway.
